title: Comprehensive Technical & Scientific Report of the 43rd Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
summary: Official MoES publication documenting the complete logistical operations, wintering crew rotations, environmental stewardship metrics, fuel consumption, and preliminary scientific outputs achieved during the 43rd Indian Antarctic Expedition across Maitri and Bharati stations.
authoringBody: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR), Ministry of Earth Sciences

title: IndARC Mooring Observational Synthesis & Arctic Winterization Assessment
summary: Technical evaluation of continuous mooring endurance, acoustic data transmission integrity, biofouling mitigation, and seasonal thermohaline structure recorded at the Ny-Ålesund IndARC site in Kongsfjorden.

title: Himalayan Cryospheric Benchmark: Annual Glacio-Hydrological Report of Chandra Basin
summary: Comprehensive glaciological stake audit, terminus retreat surveys, GPR ice depth profiling, and discharge hydrographs compiled at Himansh station for water resource planning and downstream disaster mitigation.

title: Comprehensive Environmental Impact Assessment (CEIA) for Green Renewable Energy Infrastructure at Bharati Station
summary: Environmental assessment submitted under Article 8 of the Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty, detailing solar PV micro-grid installation and noise suppression protocols.
authoringBody: Environmental Management Cell, NCPOR / Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting (ATCM)

title: Cruise Report of the 11th Indian Southern Ocean Expedition (ISOE-11) aboard SA Agulhas
summary: Official cruise proceedings documenting 34 hydrographic CTD stations, marginal ice-edge aerosol sampling, trace metal ultra-clean coring, and carbon export calculations conducted across the subtropical convergence and polar fronts.

title: 42nd ISEA Annual Meteorological Report: Maitri Base
summary: Surface meteorological record documenting annual temperature profiles, wind direction, and blizzard velocity peaks exceeding 85 knots at Maitri. Mean annual temp: -9.8°C; Peak wind speed: 85 knots (157 km/h); Station elevation: 117 m amsl.

title: Priyadarshini Freshwater Lake Subglacial Sediment Profile
summary: Microbiological isolation of psychrotolerant bacteria and paleolimnological sedimentation rates in Schirmacher Oasis freshwater bodies. Maximum depth: 6.5 m; Dominant bacterial phyla: Actinobacteria, Bacteroidetes.

title: Samudra Tapu Moraine Dammed Lake Expansion & GLOF Risk
summary: High-resolution multi-spectral satellite and field bathymetry mapping the perimeter expansion and moraine dam stability of the Samudra Tapu lake. Surface area: 1.24 km²; Breach risk level: High-Priority Alert.

title: Bara Shigri Debris Cover & Surface Velocity Dynamics
summary: Differential GPS and UAV photogrammetry evaluating how supraglacial debris thickness dampens ice melt along the main tongue of Bara Shigri. Average velocity: 22 m/year; Glacier length: 27.7 km.

title: Himadri Atmospheric Black Carbon & Aerosol Optical Depth
summary: Aethalometer and sun photometer atmospheric measurements quantifying long-range transport of anthropogenic aerosols into the High Arctic. Springtime peak BC: 85 ng/m³; Baseline summer BC: 12 ng/m³.

title: Kongsfjorden Microplastic Contamination & Zooplankton Trophic Shift
summary: Fjord surface-trawl water filtration assessing synthetic micro-fiber density and tracking boreal copepod displacement of Arctic endemic fauna. Microplastic abundance: 0.34 particles/m³; Target species: Calanus finmarchicus, Calanus glacialis.

title: Antarctic Krill Biomass Acoustics & Carbon Flux Report
summary: Multi-frequency EK60 acoustic backscatter surveys and Bongo net tows estimating krill swarm swarming density and biological pump carbon export. Target strength frequency: 120 kHz; Average krill length: 44.2 mm.

title: Sub-Antarctic Zone Microzooplankton & Pteropod Shell Dissolution
summary: Micro-CT scanning of pelagic pteropod aragonite shells collected during ISESO cruises to detect ocean acidification-induced shell dissolution. Aragonite saturation depth: 1,100 m; Shell thinning rate: 6.8% per decade.
